# Farmer

[All quest chapters](index.md)

<a id="q-744add87c231a990"></a>

## Become a Farmer

Bellemere raised two daughters on a tangerine grove and a lot of stubbornness.

Choose Farmer as one of your professions.

**Tasks**

- Choose Farmer

**Rewards**

- Doriki +60, Belly +2,000, Farmer XP +300

<a id="q-320c3485f56e7736"></a>

## Apprentice Farmer

Plant something and wait. Harder than it sounds.

Reach Farmer level 5.

**Prerequisites (all of)** — [Become a Farmer](farmer.md#q-744add87c231a990)

**Tasks**

- Reach Farmer level 5

**Rewards**

- Doriki +120, Belly +6,000, Farmer XP +800

<a id="q-37630a27f5b51f5d"></a>

## Journeyman Farmer

Cocoyasi's tangerine grove survived eight years of Arlong. Tend an orchard of your own.

Reach Farmer level 25, Plant a fruit tree sapling, Sow Ancient Rice beside water and land on a village in East Blue.

**Prerequisites (all of)** — [Apprentice Farmer](farmer.md#q-320c3485f56e7736)

**Tasks**

- Reach Farmer level 25
- Plant a fruit tree sapling
- Sow Ancient Rice beside water
- Land on a village in East Blue

**Rewards**

- Doriki +240, Belly +25,000, Farmer XP +3,000

<a id="q-5e3c3183b02ced36"></a>

## Expert Farmer

Golden fruit grows high in the windswept hills, and every fruit of the islands is out there somewhere.

Reach Farmer level 50 and complete the tasks below.

**Prerequisites (all of)** — [Journeyman Farmer](farmer.md#q-37630a27f5b51f5d)

**Tasks**

- Reach Farmer level 50
- Pick a Golden Fruit
- Gather every fruit of the islands

**Rewards**

- Doriki +480, Belly +70,000, Farmer XP +7,000, New World Crate

<a id="q-14163c0b3aeab36c"></a>

## Master Farmer

Cocoyasi has a keeper for its grove. It could be you.

Reach Farmer level 100 and earn the title.

**Prerequisites (all of)** — [Expert Farmer](farmer.md#q-5e3c3183b02ced36)

**Tasks**

- Reach Farmer level 100

**Rewards**

- Doriki +900, Belly +250,000, Legendary Crate
